title: The Aeroplane, 5 Mar 1948, p.281: parabola glider, NACA Zimmermann tests (Figs. 14-16)
description: Magazine page with a photograph captioned "Fig. 14.—A Russian 'parabola' glider of 1924" showing men standing beside the aircraft, a drawing "Fig. 15.—A 'parabola' aircraft by B. I. Tscheranowsky", and a graph "Fig. 16.—N.A.C.A. tests by C. H. Zimmermann which prove the extraordinary stalling qualities of disc wings" plotting lift coefficient against angle of incidence for various aspect ratios. Text covers Zimmermann's research and the stalling behaviour of disc wings.
